user.title: Dimplex Heat Pump (NWPM Modbus TCP)
user.description: Enter the IP address of the NWPM module and the Modbus parameters.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the IP address and port.

bypass_hot_water_lock.name: Suspend hot water block
bypass_hot_water_lock.description: Suspends the hot water block for a given duration, then automatically returns to the normal schedule.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the block is suspended, in minutes.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several heat pumps are configured.

cancel_hot_water_bypass.name: End hot water bypass
cancel_hot_water_bypass.description: Ends a running bypass immediately and restores the original schedule value.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several heat pumps are configured.

start_thermal_disinfection.name: Start thermal disinfection now
start_thermal_disinfection.description: Rewrites the schedule so the heat pump starts a disinfection run within a few minutes. The original schedule is restored automatically once the run has finished.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several heat pumps are configured.

cancel_thermal_disinfection.name: Cancel thermal disinfection
cancel_thermal_disinfection.description: Stops supervising a manually started run and restores the original schedule immediately.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several heat pumps are configured.

scan_registers.name: Scan registers (diagnostic)
scan_registers.description: Reads an address range and, on the second call, reports which addresses changed. Useful for locating undocumented datapoints.

end.name: End address
end.description: Last address to read (max. 256 per scan).

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: A single heat pump must be specified for a scan.
